description: Use when the user asks whether something they own or rely on has a problem right now: a product (barcode or description) or car (VIN or make/model/year) recalled, a medicine (NDC or name) in FDA shortage or recalled, their flight's airports under FAA ground stops/closures/delays, what is happening near a location (power outages, NWS warnings, earthquakes, disaster declarations), undeclared-allergen food recalls (allergy), tire age and recalls from a DOT code (tire), or actively exploited flaws for a device (device), expiry and recalls for a car seat, smoke alarm, CO alarm or fire extinguisher (safety: type, made, brand, model), or recalls for a home appliance by brand and model number (appliance), pet food and pet medicine recalls (pet), data breaches reported by companies they use (breach), or drinking water violations for their water system (water). Flight checks cover airport-wide disruptions, not the status of a single flight. Medicines also return what pharmacies pay (NADAC) and expiry/lot checks. Returns alert/watch/clear with official sources.

api_key.description: Optional. Your KnowAPI key for this dataset; leave it out and a free key is created (first 5 calls free within 48 hours).

companies.description: breach: companies you use, comma separated.

type.description: safety: car_seat, smoke_alarm, co_alarm or extinguisher; appliance: what it is (dryer, heater...).

name: watch_check
title: Is anything wrong with my stuff? (recalls, meds, flights, near me)
